verdict.rationale: CT Corporation is a compliance and registered-agent service that holds customer data, so whether that data can be excluded from AI model training is a fair privacy question for it. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes: the main host returned a Cloudflare challenge and the legacy host redirects there. No CT Corporation content on training opt-outs or data-use policy was reachable, so there is no evidence of this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
